title: Do not PreDepends: systemd-sysv on i386. In an effort to reduce the i386 build for systemd, we have a goal of only shipping the library packages. If we were to do that without first dropping this PreDepends, then i386 build chroots would be broken by an unsatisfied dependency.
description: Do not PreDepends: systemd-sysv on i386. In an effort to reduce the i386 build for systemd, we have a goal of only shipping the library packages. If we were to do that without first dropping this PreDepends, then i386 build chroots would be broken by an unsatisfied dependency.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index ae0cea5..5f7a07a 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+init-system-helpers (1.66ubuntu2) oracular; urgency=medium
+
+  * debian/control: do not PreDepends: systemd-sysv on i386
+    This will allow src:systemd to build fewer packages on i386, i.e. only
+    build the library packages.
+
+ -- Nick Rosbrook <enr0n@ubuntu.com>  Fri, 14 Jun 2024 11:01:55 -0400
+
